latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* [wasi-interp] fix integer overflow in wasi getMemPtr size calculation by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2752
* Use unsigned shift in GetAlignment to avoid signed overflow by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2755
* [wasm2c] Avoid size_t overflow in wasm_rt_grow table reallocation by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2756
* parse decimal float literals independent of the C locale by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2757
* [wasm-decompile] Avoid out-of-range shift in load/store rewrite by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2758
* [wasm2c] Use locale-independent ctype in GenerateHeaderGuard by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2759
* Avoid unbounded alloca in FloatParser::ParseFloat by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2754
* [interp] Use u64 table operands so out-of-range table64 indices trap by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2760
* Avoid string_view underflow in ParseCodeMetadataAnnotation by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2761
* Avoid Var::name() on function-level branches in decompiler by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2762
* Update man pages and html docs by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2763
* Avoid front() on an empty element expression in the validator by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2765
* Add ruff python linter. NFC by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2770
* Remove wasm-decompile by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2769
* Support 64 bit limits for tables by @zherczeg in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2767
* [binary-reader] Templatize LEB reading functions. NFC by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2771
* Update from C++17 to C++20 by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2772
* Add -Wno-gnu-folding-constant when compiling c api examples by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2774
* Use C++20 standard bit utilities and std::bit_cast. NFC by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2773
* [wasm2c] Write float constants independent of the host locale by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2768
* Avoid out-of-bounds section_starts_ read on invalid reloc index by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2777
* Remove ReadLeb128 type argument by @zherczeg in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2776
* [interp] Stop on first error in the binary reader fuzzer by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2778
* [cpp20] Modernize binary reader and writer APIs to use std::span by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2775
* Fix DecodeInvalidOpcode for 9-bit opcode codes by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2781
* wasm2c: (Security) fix runtime overflows when running Wasm modules with memory64 by @shravanrn in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2783
* [validator] Allow call_indirect/return_call_indirect table elements to be subtypes of funcref by @6d6f6d656e746f in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2780
* Check size overflow and calloc failure in wasm_rt_allocate_memory by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2786
* wasm2c: fix errors in atomic ops implementation by @shravanrn in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2784
* wasm2c: fix to check address + offset addition for memory64 by @shravanrn in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2785
* Bounds-check function index in name section local handlers by @aizu-m in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2787
* wasm2c: Move to O3 optimizations for wasm2c spec compliance tests by @shravanrn in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2788
* Zero-init an InitInst to avoid accessing unintialized memory by @lexi-nadia in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2789
* Mark Result as [[nodis
